battle.name: 几內亞比紹獨立戰爭
battle.brief: 中文維基《戰爭列表》所列的几內亞比紹獨立戰爭，於1963年1月由PAIGC在葡屬幾內亞發動武裝反抗，對抗葡萄牙殖民統治，成為該國爭取獨立的戰事。Steam ironclad是英國海軍於1865年服役的蒸汽鐵甲艦正式型號，屬較早期海上主力作戰艦種，負責遠洋部署、封鎖與火力支援。

kit.name: 蒸汽鐵甲艦
kit.history: 蒸汽鐵甲艦是英國海軍以蒸汽動力與鐵甲防護構成的海上主力艦種，負責巡弋、封鎖與岸轟，是遠洋編隊中兼具防護與持續作戰能力的核心兵力。

countries: 交戰的雙方，一方是葡萄牙在薩拉查獨裁體制下經營的葡屬幾內亞：里斯本派出的殖民地政府、陸軍駐軍與海空軍單位構成遠征當局。另一方是幾內亞比紹與佛得角非洲獨立黨（PAIGC）及其分布各戰區的武裝。PAIGC 一九五六年九月在比紹成立時只是一個政黨，卻在鄰國幾內亞（科納克里）設立總部、訓練營與後勤倉庫，幾內亞政府公開提供基地、港口與軍火，成為游擊隊唯一穩定的外援通道。塞內加爾在一九六九年因邊境衝突與葡軍越境追擊而封閉與葡屬幾內亞的陸路通道，外運被迫全面改走科納克里方向。阿爾及利亞同意轉運器材，古巴自一九六〇年起供應步槍與彈藥並派訓軍事顧問，蘇聯則透過古巴與阿爾及利亞提供顧問、教材與部分武器。葡萄牙身為北約成員，同盟國未曾出兵干涉；聯合國自一九六〇年代起持續把比紹列入去殖民化議程。打到一九七四年，PAIGC 的戰鬥區已由比紹內陸向南北兩端擴張，與葡方據點形成犬齒交錯的界線。
countriesEn: The conflict was fought between two sides. On one side stood Portuguese colonial Guinea under Salazar's dictatorship in Lisbon: the colonial administration, the army garrison and the naval and air units sent out from the mainland formed the expeditionary authority. On the other stood the African Party for the Independence of Guinea and Cape Verde (PAIGC) and its armed units in the military sectors. When the PAIGC was founded in Bissau in September 1956 it was only a party, yet it established headquarters, training camps and depots in neighbouring Guinea (Conakry), whose government openly provided bases, port facilities and weapons, the only dependable external supply channel of the guerrillas. After the border incidents of 1969 and Portuguese cross-border pursuit, Senegal closed the land route with Portuguese Guinea and the flow of materiel was forced entirely onto the Conakry axis. Algeria agreed to tranship weapons, Cuba supplied rifles and ammunition from 1960 onward and posted military instructors, while the Soviet Union provided advisers, training material and part of the hardware through Cuba and Algeria. Portugal, as a NATO member, was never joined by its allies on the battlefield, and the United Nations kept Guinea-Bissau on the decolonization agenda throughout the 1960s. By 1974 the PAIGC's combat zones had spread from the interior of Bissau towards both the north and the south, interlocking with the Portuguese outposts.
people: PAIGC 的核心是幾內亞出身的農業技師阿米爾卡·卡布拉爾。他在里斯本高等農業學院受訓後回國服務，對殖民地的土地與生產結構有第一手認識，一九五六年九月十九日在比紹創立 PAIGC，先走公開政治路線，一九五九年發表政治綱領，直到一九六二年底才決定轉入武裝鬥爭；一九六三年一月二十三日，他在卡薩盧一帶策劃了對提特（Tite）葡萄牙巡邏隊的第一次伏擊，行動由尼諾·維埃拉與路易斯·卡布拉爾等人率領小組執行。他的弟弟路易斯·卡布拉爾擔任政治委員，一九七三年九月二十五日在戰鬥區宣布獨立並出任流亡政府總統，一九七四年九月二十四日在比紹就任國家元首。尼諾·維埃拉是游擊隊的軍事指揮，一九七〇年代後期主持全面攻勢，一九七四年五月坎比作戰由他統籌。一九七二至一九七三年間，維克多·薩烏德·瑪利亞與阿里斯蒂德斯·佩雷拉另立旗號，黨內分裂；一九七三年一月二十日卡布拉爾在科納克里遇刺，葡萄牙情報單位的策劃由日後的國會調查認定。葡方由殖民地軍事總督輪替掌控，一九六六至一九七〇年間出任葡屬幾內亞軍事總督的安東尼奧·德·斯皮諾拉公開主張戰爭無法取勝；作戰單位除轉役軍人外，還有殖民地本地士兵與從本土調來的突擊兵特種部隊；比紹的 PIDE 與 SIS 情報單位則負責情報與特殊行動。
peopleEn: The core of the PAIGC was Amilcar Cabral, an agronomist from Portuguese Guinea who trained at the Instituto Superior de Agronomia in Lisbon and returned to the colony in the 1950s. He founded the PAIGC in Bissau on 19 September 1956, first pursuing an open political line and publishing the party's programme in 1959, and only at the end of 1962 decided on armed struggle; on 23 January 1963 he planned the first ambush, against a Portuguese patrol near Tite in the Cassalu sector, carried out by small groups under Nino Vieira and Luis Cabral among others. His brother Luis Cabral, the political commissar, proclaimed independence in the combat zones on 25 September 1973 and headed the government in exile, becoming head of state at Bissau on 24 September 1974. Nino Vieira was the guerrilla commander: he directed the general offensive of the late 1970s and planned the operation at Cumbe in May 1974. Between 1972 and 1973 Victor Saude Maria and Aristides Pereira split away to form their own group, and Amilcar Cabral was assassinated in Conakry on 20 January 1973; a later parliamentary inquiry identified the role of Portuguese intelligence in the operation. On the Portuguese side authority rotated among military governors; Antonio de Spinola, military governor of Portuguese Guinea between 1966 and 1970, argued publicly that the war could not be won. Fighting units combined transferred conscripts, colonial African soldiers and Comandos special forces dispatched from the mainland, while the PIDE and SIS intelligence services in Bissau ran information work and special operations.
kits: 葡軍步兵的基本槍械是毛瑟 98 式卡賓槍，機槍以 Steyr-Solothurn S/30（8 毫米）、vz. 61 與 vz. 52（7.62 毫米）、勃朗寧 BAR（F/31）與勃朗寧 M1917（F/37）為主，手槍用勃朗寧 High-Power .45，並仍配二戰庫存的司登與劉易斯機槍；迫擊砲為 81 毫米勃蘭特型與 60 毫米迫擊砲，彈藥供應 7.62×54mmR、8 毫米毛瑟、7.62 北約標準與 .45 ACP。運輸靠 Land Rover Series II 與卡車，通訊為可攜式收發機與野戰電話，偏遠據點依賴空投。空中支援由比紹的 Fiat G.91R、擔任砲兵觀察的 T-6、從本土調派的 F-84F，以及觀察與輕型運輸用的 Alouette III 與 Bell 47 直升機；海軍在河海與近岸用巡邏艇與登陸艇巡邏，並在主要河口布雷。PAIGC 這邊，一九六〇與一九六二年古巴運來的莫辛－納甘 91/30 步槍與 7.62×54mmR 彈藥是最早的骨幹，後續彈藥靠阿爾及利亞與古巴轉運；主力裝備則來自戰利品：繳獲的毛瑟 98 卡賓槍、vz. 61 與 vz. 52、勃朗寧 BAR、81 毫米與 60 毫米迫擊砲，以及從葡軍據點奪來的便攜式無線電與 7.62 毫米彈藥。游擊隊把這些槍械按每個班組的實際需求重新分配，一個班常同時攜帶步槍、卡賓槍與機槍。
kitsEn: Portuguese infantry used the Mauser 98k carbine as its standard weapon, with the Steyr-Solothurn S/30 in 8mm, vz. 61 and vz. 52 in 7.62mm, the Browning automatic rifle (F/31) and the Browning M1917 (F/37) as machine guns, the Browning High-Power .45 as sidearm, and Second World War surplus Sten and Lewis guns still in use. Mortars were the 81mm Brandt and the 60mm, and the ammunition supply covered 7.62x54mmR, 8mm Mauser, 7.62 NATO and .45 ACP. Transport was by Land Rover Series II and trucks, communications by portable sets and field telephones, with airdrop for the most isolated posts. Air support came from Fiat G.91R aircraft at Bissau, T-6s for artillery spotting, F-84Fs detached from the mainland, and Alouette III and Bell 47 helicopters for observation and light transport; the navy patrolled estuaries and offshore waters with patrol craft and landing craft and mined the main river mouths. On the PAIGC side the backbone at first was the Mosin-Nagant 91/30 rifle and 7.62x54mmR ammunition shipped from Cuba in 1960 and 1962, with later rounds routed through Algeria and Cuba; most of the equipment, however, was booty: captured Mauser 98 carbines, vz. 61 and vz. 52 machine guns, Browning automatic rifles, 81mm and 60mm mortars, and portable radios and 7.62mm ammunition taken from Portuguese positions. The guerrillas distributed this materiel according to the real needs of each squad, and a single squad often carried rifles, carbines and machine guns at once.
tactics: PAIGC 的戰法建立在數人至十餘人的小班組之上，班組沿林間小徑與道路夜間移動，以伏擊對付巡邏、補給車隊與孤立據點，在葡軍推進線與道路兩側埋設地雷，用機槍與迫擊砲壓制敵陣地。他們避免與葡軍主力正面交戰，接觸時間控制在數小時內，戰後分散成小組往內陸撤走。營區集中在內陸，設有武器修理所、糧食囤積點與傷員後送路線；一九七〇年前後武裝正式整編為人民解放軍，下分戰區、旅、作戰大隊與班，幹部在古巴、阿爾及利亞與蘇聯受訓後返國訓練新兵。葡方以特殊戰爭配合常規手段：四至八人的強化巡邏攜帶無線電，遭襲時可呼叫空軍與砲兵支援；車隊前出派偵察班；對戰鬥區發動大規模清剿，步兵沿主要軸線推進，以迫擊砲、81 毫米砲與飛機搜索林區與可疑集結點，直升機吊運小組與補給；突擊兵則執行長途追蹤與破壞後方任務。情報單位提供的線索決定了各次伏擊的設伏位置。
tacticsEn: PAIGC tactics were built around squads of a few men to a little over ten, moving at night along forest paths and tracks, ambushing patrols, supply columns and isolated posts, laying mines along Portuguese advance lines and roads, and using machine guns and mortars to pin down enemy positions. They avoided set-piece battles with the main Portuguese force and kept engagements to a few hours, breaking into small groups and withdrawing inland after contact. Camps were kept in the interior with repair shops, food depots and evacuation routes for the wounded, and around 1970 the armed force was reorganized formally as the Exercito Popular de Libertacao, divided into sectors, brigades, combat companies and squads, with cadres trained in Cuba, Algeria and the Soviet Union and returned to train new recruits. The Portuguese side combined special war with conventional means: reinforced patrols of four to eight men carried radios and could call for air and artillery support; scouts went ahead of protected convoys; large clearing operations were mounted against the combat zones, with infantry advancing along the main axes, mortars, 81mm guns and aircraft working the forest and suspected concentrations, helicopters lifting teams and weapons, and Comandos sent out for long-range pursuit and destruction of rear areas. The intelligence services supplied the leads that set the ambushes.
data: 關鍵時序：一九五六年九月十九日 PAIGC 在比紹成立；一九五九年公開政治綱領；一九六三年一月二十三日提特伏擊，即第一次武裝行動；一九六四年起按戰區整編，葡軍增援並展開清剿；一九六六至一九七〇年斯皮諾拉出任軍事總督；一九六九年七月塞內加爾邊境事件與封閉邊界；一九七〇年前後游擊隊整編為人民解放軍；一九七三年一月於提特舉行十週年武器閱兵；一九七三年一月二十日卡布拉爾在科納克里遇刺；一九七三年九月二十五日在戰鬥區宣布獨立；一九七四年四月二十五日葡萄牙康乃馨革命；一九七四年五月十日坎比攻擊與葡軍反擊；一九七四年九月十五日阿爾及爾協議；一九七四年九月二十四日在比紹宣布獨立；一九七五年七月五日佛得角獨立；一九七五年九月十日聯合國接納。數字方面，葡軍駐軍兵力巔峰約一萬四千人上下；葡方官方結算約八千人死亡、逾兩萬人受傷，該數字包含作戰、疾病與意外事故。游擊隊的人數、裝備與損失從未可靠統計，各種估計從數百到數千不等；一九六三年提特一役雙方公布的傷亡數字相差數倍，至今沒有可核對的一致結論。
dataEn: Key dates: 19 September 1956, founding of the PAIGC in Bissau; 1959, publication of the political programme; 23 January 1963, the ambush at Tite, the first armed action; from 1964 the reorganization into sectors and Portuguese reinforcements and clear-up operations; 1966 to 1970, Spinola as military governor; July 1969, the border incidents with Senegal and the closing of the frontier; around 1970 the reorganization of the guerrillas as the Exercito Popular de Libertacao; January 1973, the weapons parade at Tite for the tenth anniversary; 20 January 1973, the killing of Cabral in Conakry; 25 September 1973, the declaration of independence in the combat zones; 25 April 1974, the Carnation Revolution in Portugal; 10 May 1974, the attack on Cumbe and the Portuguese counter-offensive; 15 September 1974, the Algiers agreement; 24 September 1974, independence declared at Bissau; 5 July 1975, independence of Cape Verde; 10 September 1975, admission to the United Nations. On numbers, Portuguese strength in the colony peaked at around fourteen thousand men. The Portuguese official count is about eight thousand dead and more than twenty thousand wounded, a figure that includes deaths from disease and accidents as well as combat losses. The strength, equipment and losses of the guerrillas were never reliably counted: estimates range from several hundred to several thousand, and the figures published by both sides for the Tite action of 1963 differ severalfold, with no consensus surviving to this day.
cause: 根本原因是里斯本拒絕承認比紹有權決定自身政治前途。殖民地經濟只為港口與鐵路走廊的收益而設計，沒有讓步的打算；PAIGC 先以公開政治與議會途徑爭取改革，遭到 PIDE 的逮捕、驅逐與監視，遂轉入武裝道路。黨於一九五六年九月十九日以幾內亞非洲獨立黨之名成立，一九六一年合併佛得角的反殖民組織後改稱 PAIGC，一九六三年一月的阿爾及爾會議則把它納入全球反帝運動的網絡。外部壓力同樣關鍵：一九六〇年代的去殖民主義浪潮與印度在一九六一年兼併果阿，已顯示葡萄牙帝國難以為繼；古巴革命後向非洲解放運動輸出武器、顧問與訓練名額；幾內亞與塞內加爾的地理位置提供後勤與庇護。戰爭本身更超出殖民政府的支付能力，兵員、外匯與飛行小時大量消耗，軍隊內部對戰爭的厭倦與反戰言論在一九七四年春天的軍事政變中成為直接導火線之一。
causeEn: The root cause was Lisbon's refusal to accept that Guinea-Bissau had the right to decide its own political future. The colonial economy was built to extract revenue from the ports and the railway corridor and was not prepared to concede anything; the PAIGC first sought reform through elections and open political agitation, was met with arrests and expulsions by the PIDE, and turned to arms. The party was founded on 19 September 1956 as the Partido Africano da Independencia da Guinea and took the name PAIGC in 1961 after absorbing the Cape Verde organization, while the Algiers congress of January 1963 drew it into a global anti-imperial network. Outside the colony, the decolonization tide of the 1960s and India's annexation of Goa in 1961 had already shown that the Portuguese empire was coming apart; the Cuban revolution began shipping weapons, instructors and training places to African liberation movements; Senegalese and Guinean territory offered rear bases and sanctuary. The war itself was also beyond the colonial government's means, consuming manpower, foreign exchange and aircraft hours to a degree that turned the Portuguese military against the war, and that exhaustion formed one of the immediate causes of the military coup of April 1974.
impact: 這場戰爭成為葡萄牙帝國代價最高的戰役，兵員、外匯與飛行時間被一個控制內陸的對手持續消耗，軍隊由此產生的不滿構成一九七四年四月二十五日革命最切近的背景之一，斯皮諾拉的證詞與關於幾內亞戰爭的報告都進入公共記錄。葡軍的北約盟國擔憂共產勢力在非洲落地，卻始終沒有出兵，戰爭的勝負在殖民地內部而非歐洲首都決定。PAIGC 則獲得其他非洲解放運動尚未具備的東西：一支有政治信念、有古巴與蘇聯訓練管道、有完整後勤體系的軍隊，因此獨立到來時，黨的幹部可以立即接手國家機器。比紹所驗證的內陸游擊區、進攻性游擊與跨境補給的模式，隨後成為安哥拉與莫桑比克解放運動的樣板。一九七三年卡布拉爾遇刺與一九七二至七三年的分裂也讓 PAIGC 付出早期團結的代價；而整場戰爭同時證明，缺乏步兵營與空軍掩護的城市攻擊不可能成立。
impactEn: The Guinea war became the most expensive campaign of the Portuguese empire: manpower, foreign exchange and aircraft hours were consumed by an opponent holding the interior, and the disaffection it produced in the army was one of the immediate backgrounds to the 25 April 1974 revolution, with Spinola's testimony and the reports on the Guinea war forming part of the public record. Portugal's NATO allies watched with concern about communist influence but did not intervene, and the campaign was decided inside the colony rather than in European capitals. The PAIGC emerged with something the other African movements did not yet have: an army with political conviction, a training pipeline in Cuba and the Soviet Union and a working logistics system, so that when independence came the party cadres could take over the state machinery at once. The pattern tested in Guinea-Bissau, an interior guerrilla zone, offensive guerrilla action and supply lines running across a neighbouring frontier, served as a model for the Angolan and Mozambican movements. The assassination of Cabral in 1973 and the split of 1972 to 1973 also cost the PAIGC its early unity, and the war showed that an urban assault could not be carried without infantry concentration and air cover.
result: 結果是 PAIGC 的勝利。一九七四年九月十五日阿爾及爾協議後，葡軍分批撤出，最後一批部隊於十月離開；同年九月二十四日，比紹宣布獨立，翌年九月十日獲聯合國接納。獨立宣言宣稱與幾內亞合併，但科納克里與達卡爾既未落實也未維護這項安排，佛得角更於一九七五年七月五日另行獨立。PAIGC 執政後於一九七六年改稱 PAI，維克多·薩烏德·瑪利亞另立的一派則沿用 PAIGC 名號，後組為 UPAG，兩派長期對立，一九八〇年十一月二十二日若昂·貝爾納多·維埃拉的政變終結了兩派共治的格局。葡國方面，結果是幾內亞、幾內亞比紹、佛得角，以及其後的安哥拉與莫桑比克全數失去。戰爭以一個贏得戰場的武裝運動接管國家收場，而它接手的是葡軍留下的行政與軍隊骨架。
resultEn: The result was a PAIGC victory. After the Algiers agreement of 15 September 1974 the Portuguese forces withdrew in stages, the last units leaving in October; Guinea-Bissau declared independence at Bissau on 24 September 1974, and the United Nations admitted it on 10 September 1975. The declaration proclaimed a union with Guinea, but Conakry and Dakar neither implemented nor sustained it, and Cape Verde went its own way on 5 July 1975. The PAIGC took power and renamed itself the PAI in 1976, while the group led by Victor Saude Maria continued under the PAIGC name and later formed the UPAG, remaining in long-term opposition; the 22 November 1980 coup of Joao Bernardo Vieira ended the arrangement in which both factions had shared power. On the Portuguese side the outcome was the loss of Guinea, Guinea-Bissau, Cape Verde and, shortly afterwards, Angola and Mozambique. The war ended with an armed movement that had won the battlefield taking over a state whose administrative and military skeleton was the one the Portuguese left behind.
